claims.text: In WorkflowStepContainer.tsx, users can trigger multiple verification SMS sends before the first resolves because the button is not disabled during sendVerificationCodeMutation.isLoading
In workflows.tsx, deleteScheduledEmailReminder is called with immediateDelete=true which reintroduces direct SendGrid cancellation that the PR is moving away from
What does SendGrid actually return when a cancel request is sent a second time for a batch that was already cancelled versus one that's about to be sent?
The cron cancellation query is missing a `method: WorkflowMethods.EMAIL` filter, so it would also pick up SMS reminders once SMS adopts the same deferred-cancellation pattern.
The conditional-rendering refactor in WorkflowStepContainer.tsx is unrelated to this PR's reminder-lifecycle subject matter and should be split into its own commit or PR.

In scheduleEmailReminders.ts, if SendGrid API call fails for one reminder, the loop exits early and remaining reminders are not processed, while DB deletions collected before failure are still executed

The cancellation pass in scheduleEmailReminders.ts should restrict to reminders that are already scheduled email sends - otherwise an unscheduled or non-email reminder can produce an invalid SendGrid batch_id and prevent other cancellations from running
Is `Prisma.Prisma__WorkflowReminderClient` actually nested under the `Prisma` namespace in the types generated by @prisma/client 4.8?
The cron cancellation loop has no per-item error isolation; a single failure aborts the remaining cancellations in that run and skips deleting records that were already successfully cancelled.

Cancelling a booking now marks the reminder record as cancelled and defers the actual cancellation to a cron job, but the cron handler's deleteMany runs before the cancellation query, so any reminder scheduled to fire before the next cron run will still be sent and the situation can never be recovered afterward.

The SendGrid call assumes reminder.referenceId is always a valid batch id; if it's null/empty (or for non-email rows), this will throw and the reminder won't be deleted, causing repeated failures on subsequent runs
The new try/catch added in handleNewBooking is structurally incapable of catching anything, since the calls inside it are unawaited and the errors they could throw are already swallowed internally.
Passing `true` to deleteScheduledEmailReminder bypasses the new deferred email-cancellation flow and reintroduces the SendGrid cancellation-cap bug for reschedules
In schema.prisma, missing composite index on (cancelled, scheduledDate) for WorkflowReminder which could cause slow queries as the table grows
The new `cancelled` column is a nullable Boolean with no default value, turning what should be a two-state flag into a three-state one.

Because cancellations are processed after the earlier delete-by-date logic, if this cron runs late a cancelled reminder could be removed from DB without ever sending the corresponding SendGrid cancellation request
In WorkflowStepContainer.tsx, verification can be submitted with empty phone number or empty code, causing unnecessary mutation calls
In WorkflowStepContainer.tsx, hardcoded strings 'Verification code' placeholder and 'Verify' button label bypass i18n

The cancellation loop in the CRON job wraps a single try-catch around the entire for loop. If any SendGrid cancellation request fails, the loop breaks immediately - all subsequent reminders are skipped and none of the accumulated prisma.workflowReminder.delete queries execute. A persistently failing reminder would block all other cancellations every CRON run. The try-catch should be moved inside the for loop to match the per-iteration pattern used by the scheduling loop.
In scheduleEmailReminders.ts, reminder.referenceId is nullable but passed directly to SendGrid API which expects a valid batch_id, causing API errors for reminders without a referenceId
The cancellation semantics were rewritten across seven call sites, but no test covers any of this behavior.
What scheduler and frequency does production/self-host actually use to trigger the scheduleEmailReminders cron endpoint?
In scheduleEmailReminders.ts, the cancellation query doesn't filter by method: EMAIL, which could inadvertently process SMS reminders marked as cancelled

When immediateDelete is true, the deleteScheduledEmailReminder function cancels the SendGrid email but fails to delete the corresponding WorkflowReminder record from the database. This creates orphaned database entries and is inconsistent with the immediateDelete: false path, which marks the record as cancelled. The SendGrid DELETE API call is also omitted in this path.

Asynchronous functions deleteScheduledEmailReminder and deleteScheduledSMSReminder are called without await inside forEach loops. This occurs during booking rescheduling/cancellation, and workflow/workflow step deletion/updates. Consequently, scheduled workflow reminders may not be reliably cancelled, potentially leaving them active.
Three files reverted `import type` back to plain value imports; in one of them (workflows.tsx) the newly value-imported `Prisma` symbol is never used.
In workflows.tsx, PrismaPromise is used only as a type but imported as a runtime value instead of using type-only import

Missing method filter in remindersToCancel query - fetches all cancelled WorkflowReminder rows regardless of method, which could cause SendGrid batch-cancel API to be called with Twilio SID if SMS path changes
Single try-catch wrapping entire cancellation loop causes all remaining reminders to be skipped if any single SendGrid call fails, allowing emails to be sent instead of cancelled
